You will be trained as a multi-skilled worker and deployed across 8 different workstations.

On a typical day:

Does this sound like you? Apply right away!

Are you driven by people, motivated by success and energized by building relationships? Do you enjoy spotting opportunities, making things happen and working in a team where ambition and collaboration go hand in hand? Then this could be your next career move.

As a Recruitment Consultant at Robert Walters, you'll combine your commercial drive with your passion for people. You'll connect organizations with experienced professionals, develop your own network and play a key role in helping businesses find the expertise they need.

We are looking to strengthen our Interim Management team in Brussels. If you're ambitious, entrepreneurial and ready to take ownership of your career, we'd love to meet you.

Your role

As a Recruitment Consultant, you'll be part of our Interim Management team, working at the intersection of people, business and opportunity.

You'll manage the recruitment process from start to finish, while building long-term relationships with organizations and professionals. No two days are the same: one moment you could develop a new business opportunity, the next you're speaking with an experienced professional about their next career move.

You'll have the opportunity to:

• Build and grow your own network of organizations and professionals within the Interim Management market
• Identify new business opportunities by understanding what organizations need and where you can add value
• Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with business partners
• Search for, assess and connect experienced professionals with the right interim management opportunities
• Manage the recruitment process from first contact through to successful placement
• Arrange interviews and ensure clear, proactive communication throughout the process
• Meet with prospective business partners and deepen existing relationships
• Proactively develop your portfolio through networking, market outreach and business development
• Work closely with your colleagues, sharing market knowledge, ideas and expertise
• Contribute to the success of the wider team while building your own track record
You'll have real ownership, clear targets and plenty of opportunities to make an impact.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is commercially minded, ambitious and genuinely interested in people.

You'll bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree combined with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience within operations / finance 
• Excellent Dutch and very good English communication skills
• A strong commercial mindset and a genuine drive to achieve results
• An entrepreneurial attitude and the confidence to create and pursue new opportunities
• Strong negotiation skills and a strategic approach
• A natural interest in business, people and the world of work
• A strong team spirit and a collaborative mindset
You're someone who takes initiative, enjoys a challenge and isn't afraid to pick up the phone or open a new door. You know how to build trust, you're comfortable working towards targets and you're motivated by seeing the impact of your work. Above all, you're looking for more than just a job: you want to build a career where your ambition can grow with you.

Client Details

The company is located in Brussels.

Description

As a Finance Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.

• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.

• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
• Ability to communicate effectively in both English and French.

Toyota offers a comprehensive remuneration package, including interesting extra-legal benefits. Toyota provides flexibility to take care of both your career and your personal life by providing hybrid work environment with structural possibility to both work from home & collaborate in the office. 

At Toyota Motor Europe, they are committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all. All recruitment decisions are based on the individual and their qualifications along with the job requirements. The selection process is without regard to nationality, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, date of birth, religion, ethnicity, disability or other personal characteristics. Toyota do not tolerate harassment or discrimination as our individual experiences and overall diversity is a key strength. Together, let's have the power to make a positive change and go beyond the ordinary. If you need any specific consideration for the interview process due to disability or any other reason, please let the recruiter know.

Jobomschrijving

Team/division description

Material Engineering division widely contributes to Toyota development activities from vehicle development projects to fundamental research. Our team is committed to develop solutions and to introduce attractive & environment-friendly materials towards circular economy, carbon neutrality and customer happiness.

Your responsibilities
	
• Prepare Purchase Orders, and proceed receiving and invoicing 	
• Process technical reports towards official issuance acc. to our internal process 	
• Prepare and format documents, reports, presentations	
• Establish guidelines and procedures 	
• Actively propose and implement cost reduction and efficiency ideas 	
• Support the team’s digitalization processes 	
• Manage calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate appointments. 	
• Support internal and external communication with stakeholders. 	
• Assist in organizing events, workshops, and team activities. 

Your profile
	
• Proven experience as administrative assistant 	
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.	
• Rigorous and self-disciplined	
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Flemish and French are a plus.	
• A very good knowledge of Excel is required (advanced formulas, pivot table...), and powerBI. A good command of powerApp is a plus.	
• Discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive information.	
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.	
• You have a Toyota DNA, this means:
Courage: you are ready to let go of the easy path to reach challenging targets Collaboration: you are a team player, respectful and inclusive in your style and you take a customer-oriented approach

Creativity: your passion drives you to explore innovative ideas and challenge the impossible

Curiosity: you combine imagination and fact-based observation

Coaching: you share knowledge and feedback with your colleagues and celebrate each other’s success

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology enterprise bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this initiative, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do
	
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.	
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.	
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.	
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.	
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.
Good to Know
You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends, but no night shifts. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
	
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.	
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.	
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 	
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.	
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

• Assemble AI-Blox devices under the supervision and guidance of the engineering team
• Support device testing and validation activities led by the engineering team
• Prepare materials and components for assembly activities, including picking items from the warehouse to supply workstations
• Perform inventory counting and stock-taking activities to maintain accurate inventory records
• Organize, clean and optimize warehouse spaces to improve efficiency and accessibility
• Inspect assembled units and components to ensure quality and completeness
• Handle materials, tools and equipment safely and responsibly
• Assist the operations team with general production and logistics-related tasks as needed 
• Hands-on mentality with an interest in assembling technical or electromechanical products
• Comfortable working with tools, hardware components and production materials
• Organized, detail-oriented and able to work independently
• Physically capable of lifting and moving boxes, materials and equipment
• Proactive attitude and willingness to support different operational activities
• Experience in assembly, warehouse operations or production environments is a plus
• Basic understanding of electronics or electromechanical systems is an advantage
• Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment
• Good communication skills in English
• Available from October
• Able to work in our Brussels office on a fulltime basis 
• A fixed term contract of 3 months (possibility to extend)
• The chance to work in a fast-growing tech/AI startup
• Hands-on experience with cutting-edge AI hardware
• A dynamic, international and collaborative team
• An innovative workplace in the centre of Brussels

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists

• Preparing completed orders for shipment

• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work

• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment

• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker with CE driving licence - code 95 not needed!
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced warehouse worker or truck driver who enjoys working nights? Do you already in Belgium? And can you operate an electric pallet truck (EPT) and do you have experience moving and coupling trailers? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

For a leading specialist in frozen food transport and logistics, located in Oostkamp, we are looking for a versatile warehouse operator who can act as a truck shunter when necessary. The company is very open to people who only speak English, so you're free to apply if you don't speak Dutch (yet)!

Your responsibilities

In this job, you'll have a highly varied role combining warehouse logistics and yard operations.

Working in the freezer warehouse with an electric pallet truck, you'll:

• Load and unload trucks

• Move pallets between different departments

• Prepare costumer orders

Working in the yard with a terminal tractor (terberg), you'll

• Couple and uncouple trailers

• Move and position trailers around the company's private grounds

• Set and monitor trailer temperatures

Is this your profile?

• ALREADY LIVING AND PERMITTED TO WORK IN BELGIUM

• Experience with an EPT (licence not required)

• Experience coupling and moving trailers

• Comfortable working in a frozen warehouse environment

• Own transportation to the company in Oostkamp (no public transport nearby)

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this could be your new job!

Nice to have, but not obligated:

• Experience with reach truck

• Experience driving a terberg, tugmaster or other terminal tractor

• Driving licence CE

As you won't be driving on the road, a valid code 95 is not required (but a big plus)!

As a CE driver, you carry out regional distribution runs and deliver goods safely, accurately and with a strong focus on customer service to a wide range of customers.

You will join a growing transport company specialised in national distribution. Safety, reliability and customer focus are key. You can count on clear agreements, personal guidance and a working environment where drivers are valued.

You leave from Desteldonk every day with a dedicated truck. You carry out distribution runs for various customers and are given the necessary independence and responsibility. The planning team provides clear structure, and you have fixed points of contact you can turn to with any questions.

- You carry out regional or national distribution runs for a variety of customers.
- You leave from Desteldonk every day with a dedicated truck.
- You transport goods safely and professionally.
- You follow the schedule and ensure punctual deliveries.
- You communicate with customers in a friendly and professional manner.
- You take responsibility for your routes and equipment.
- You can count on support from the planning team and HR.
- You receive internal training and guidance from experienced colleagues and coaches.

You work from Monday to Friday. You start each day between 4:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m., depending on your route schedule.
- Vaardigheden:
You are customer-oriented and punctual.
You take responsibility while on the road.
You have a flexible and professional attitude.
You preferably live within a 20-kilometre radius of Desteldonk.
You enjoy working independently and value clear agreements.

- Attesten:
Valid CE driving licence, valid medical fitness certificate, Code 95 Certificate of Professional Competence and digital tachograph driver card.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
No specific diploma required.

- Vakkennis:
Experience as a driver or in distribution transport is an advantage, but not required.

- Talenkennis:
You speak Dutch, French or English.

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company

• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations

• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities

• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles

• Supervise external contractors and service providers

You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field

• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics

• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written

• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks

• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods

• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics

• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)

• Can work in a 2-shift system

• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments

• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks

• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods

• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics

• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease

• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments

• Specifically want to work in night shift

• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

In this role, you ensure that the packaging department operates smoothly from start to finish.

• Prepare and organize the daily packaging activities.
• Guide employees and distribute tasks across the team.
• Keep a close eye on product quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
• Follow up on packaging orders and coordinate priorities.
• Act quickly when technical or operational issues occur.
• Look for practical ways to improve efficiency on the production floor.
• Maintain clear communication with production planning and finished goods storage.
• Keep the Production Manager informed about progress and possible challenges.
• Help introduce and optimize the use of MES and ERP systems within the department.

• A first experience in production is preferred; experience in the food industry is a strong advantage.
• You are confident when guiding colleagues and making decisions on the work floor.
• A practical mindset and a flexible attitude come naturally to you.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality and detail.
• Good English communication skills are required.
• You are comfortable using computer systems and willing to learn new software.
• Working in two shifts fits your availability.
